snippet.title: Wall World 2 | Console Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/wall-world-2-switch/
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018024
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/wall-world-2/9NXMXPZHFS2N

The adventure in the mysterious world of the Wall continues! Pilot your robospider into its depths, uncover lost artifacts and technologies, upgrade your exosuit and spider, and battle the horrors lurking in the dark. Unravel the mysteries buried in the depths of the Wall!
